passage:
Astronauts grew small plants in space as part of an experiment. Students watched videos of leaves growing without normal gravity.
The teacher explained that future long space journeys may need fresh food. Plants can also help astronauts feel connected to Earth.
A student said the plants looked ordinary. The teacher smiled. "That is why they are amazing. Something ordinary on Earth becomes difficult in space."
The class then tried growing plants under different conditions in the school lab.
The space garden made them see farming differently. Growing food is not simple. It depends on gravity, light, water, air, and care-things people on Earth often take for granted.
